quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: Driver approaches a statutory intersection; another vehicle has entered that same intersection from a different highway.

obligation.description: Approaching driver yields the right-of-way to the entered vehicle.

exceptions: Opposite-direction approach with one driver intending or making a left turn exclusion

timing.description: Other vehicle entry precedes ego's approach and crossing entry.

judgment_calls_needed.note: No numeric yield cutoff is supplied by the statute.
Median opening and separate roadway geometry require source review; body overlap alone is not legal identity.
